answer: Ivory Staked Attestation Mesh. 1) An ivory validator holds a verified credential and operates the registry. 2) To admit a newcomer into the lagoon partition, two existing members must endorse them. 3) Every endorser commits a forge deposit of 50 tokens that is burned if the invitee cheats.
